contentHtml:
ABOUT REVIVA

Beautiful skin
begins with trust.

A modern dermatology destination built on board-certified expertise, advanced technology and an obsession with natural-looking results.

We believe that high-quality dermatological treatments can make a difference in people's lives.

In Reviva Skin & Surgery Clinic We are committed to provide cutting-edge dermatological care that improves not just the appearance of your skin but also increases your confidence. We concentrate on providing results-oriented, safe and customized treatment options for a range of hair, skin and aesthetic issues. If you're looking for professional-grade care that is patient-focused approach, our clinic is regarded as a reputable choice.

By combining modern technology and medical knowledge our goal is to revolutionize the norms of beauty and cosmetology. Every procedure we provide at our clinic is crafted to guarantee longevity in skin health and beautiful and natural outcomes.

Meet Our Expert - Dr. Aarushi Tyagi

Dr. Aarushi Tyagi (MBBS, MD, DNB Dermatology, Leprosy and Venereology) is a highly trained and board-certified dermatologist specializing in treating hair, skin nails, and venereal illnesses. She is well-known for her precision, focus on particulars, and an artistic approach, specifically in the field of cosmetology.

With a strong academic foundation, Dr. Aarushi Tyagi completed her MBBS from Kasturba Medical College, Mangalore, followed by an MD in Dermatology from Government Medical College, Patiala. She further strengthened her expertise by earning a DNB in Dermatology. Additionally, she has obtained a prestigious fellowship in injectables and aesthetic dermatology from Delhi, enhancing her proficiency in advanced cosmetology treatments.

Her focus is on understanding the individual needs of each patient and delivering individualized treatment strategies. It doesn't matter if it's treating chronic skin problems or improving the appearance of your skin, she will ensure that each patient receives the best quality of care.

Her commitment to excellence as well as the satisfaction of her patients has enabled her to successfully treat over 500 patients, which makes her a well-known brand in the field of dermatology.

Our Achievements at a Glance

In the Reviva Skin & Surgery Clinic Our outcomes speak for themselves. We have a constant focus on high-quality treatment and satisfaction of patients has led us to:

01 5000+ Patients Treated
02 98% Success Rate
03 8+ Years of Combined Experience

These milestones show our commitment to provide effective treatments while creating long-term trust with our patients.

Education & Qualifications

Our clinic is supported by academic excellence as well as expert training to ensure that each treatment is based on the latest research and cutting-edge dermatology practices.

Academic Journey:

01

MBBS – Kasturba Medical College, Mangalore

Built a strong foundation in medical sciences and clinical practice.

02

Internship - Sir Ganga Ram Hospital, New Delhi

Acquired hands-on experience in a highly regarded multi-specialty medical hospital.

03

MD Dermatology - Government Medical College, Patiala

Specialists in dermatology, venereology and leprosy, with extensive clinical exposure.

04

DNB Dermatology - National Board of Education

Advanced specialization, with a focus on diagnosing and treating dermatological problems.

05

Advanced Training - Injectables & Aesthetic Medicine

Specific training in modern methods of cosmetology that produce healthy and natural results.

The solid educational background of this doctor ensures the patients get treatments safe and compatible with the most current advances in dermatology.

Our Approach to Skin & Aesthetic Care

In the Reviva Skin & Surgery Clinic We follow a holistic and patient-centric method. We believe that each patient's skin is unique which is why treatments should be tailored according to.

What Defines Our Approach:

01

Personalized Care: Every treatment program is custom-designed according to the type of skin, issue and life style.

02

Modern Technology: We employ modern technology and methods to ensure secure and efficient outcomes.

03

Clinically-based treatments: all treatments are supported by research and dermatological guidelines.

04

Naturally Beautiful Results. Our objective is to improve your natural beauty, not altering it.

In everything from medical dermatology, to the most advanced aesthetic procedures, we will ensure that each patient receives complete treatment under one center.

Why Choose Reviva Skin & Surgery Clinic?

Picking the right dermatology clinic is vital to getting the most effective outcomes. Here at Reviva Skin & Surgery Clinic We distinguish ourselves by our commitment to quality as well as our commitment to patient satisfaction.

Key Reasons to Trust Us:

01 The expertise of a board-certified dermatologist
02 Make sure you are aware of safety and hygiene standards
03 Utilization of the most advanced and tested techniques
04 Transparent consultation and honest advice
05 A high level of satisfaction for patients and a proven rate of success

Our goal is to create a welcoming and supportive atmosphere where patients can feel comfortable about their journey to treatment.

Our Commitment to You

We are at Reviva Skin & Surgery Clinic Our goal isn't only to treat skin problems but to assist you in achieving healthy, radiant as well-groomed skin. We're committed to offering solutions that are secure, efficient and adapted to your unique requirements.

We recognize that concerns with hair and skin can affect your confidence and your quality of your life. We focus on providing results that aren't just visible, but also last for a long time.

Begin Your Journey With Us

Need Dermatology Solutions?

Let's Start Now

Your skin needs professional care and attention. We at Reviva Skin & Surgery Clinic we will assist you in every step of your skin care journey. No matter if you're facing an illness or want to look to improve your appearance our clinic has the ideal blend of knowledge and modern technology.

Get the best dermatology treatment that blends science, precision and trust - as your skin needs the very best.
